scope: Retained CPU reproduction and exact installed-source identity; no JIT experiment rerun and no cluster calls.
source_reading: _get_cache returns the existing module-global _cache and only initializes if None. _initialize_cache is guarded by _cache_initialized and captures config.compilation_cache_dir when creating the file cache. Updating the config value alone does not replace the initialized object.
preflight_connection: The audited S/H preflight shared one PID and H configured path was absent at cleanup. Exact-version CPU reproduction and matching library source establish a mechanism consistent with that anomaly; they do not independently inventory the actual remote H cache entries or prove their final physical location.
required_future_gate: A fresh replay process per target avoids this specific demonstrated initialized-object reuse. Actual per-key byte visibility and target deserialization/hits still require separate completed evidence. No acceptance of active campaigns is implied.
